units.source_text: 对此凄凉暮色而漠然无动于衷，未免太不识情趣了。

en.t: It would be far too insensitive to remain unmoved by this desolate evening light.

units.source_text: 在此时节，眺望郊原日渐枯黄的野草，也可使人感慨呢。”

en.t: At this season, even gazing at the wild grasses on the outskirts as they grow more yellow and withered day by day can stir one's feelings."

units.source_text: 大女公子看了信对妹妹说：“我确已太不识情趣，

en.t: After reading the letter, the elder young lady said to her younger sister, "I truly have been much too lacking in feeling,

units.source_text: 有好几次不写回信给他了。

en.t: for several times now I have failed to write him a reply.

units.source_text: 还是你写吧。”

en.t: You had better write instead."

units.source_text: 她照例劝二女公子写回信。

en.t: As usual, she urged the younger young lady to write the reply.

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“我不能追随父亲，苟安偷生，

en.t: The younger young lady thought, "Unable to follow my father in death, I have gone on living in shameful ease,

units.source_text: 直到今日，哪有心情取笔砚来写信！

en.t: and even now, how could I have the heart to take up brush and inkstone and write a letter!

units.source_text: 想不到忧愁苦恨，挨过了这许多日子。”

en.t: I never thought I would endure so many days of sorrow, pain, and bitterness."

units.source_text: 眼泪又夺眶而出，模糊不能见物，

en.t: Tears again burst from her eyes, blurring everything so that she could not see.

units.source_text: 便把笔砚推开，说道：“我也不能写。

en.t: She pushed away the brush and inkstone and said, "I cannot write either.

units.source_text: 我气力全无，起坐也很勉强。

en.t: I have no strength at all, and even sitting up or lying down is a struggle.

units.source_text: 谁言悲哀终有限度？

en.t: Who can say that grief must one day have a limit?

units.source_text: 我的忧伤苦恨无有了时呢！”

en.t: My sorrow, pain, and bitterness will never come to an end!"

units.source_text: 说罢哭泣甚哀。

en.t: When she had said this, she wept in deep anguish.

units.source_text: 大女公子也觉得她很可怜。

en.t: The elder young lady, too, felt great pity for her.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的使者是傍晚从京中出发、黄昏稍过到达这里的。

en.t: Prince Niou's messenger had left the capital in the evening and arrived here a little after dusk.

units.source_text: 大女公子叫人对他说：“此刻你怎么回去呢？

en.t: The elder young lady had someone say to him, "How can you return at this hour?

units.source_text: 不如在此留宿一宵，明晨再走吧。”

en.t: Why not stay here for the night and set out again tomorrow morning?"

units.source_text: 使者答道：“不敢奉命。

en.t: The messenger replied, "I am afraid I cannot obey your command.

units.source_text: 主人吩咐今晚必须回去。”

en.t: My master ordered me to return without fail tonight."

units.source_text: 他急于要走。

en.t: He was in a hurry to leave.

units.source_text: 大女公子颇感为难。

en.t: The elder young lady felt rather troubled.

units.source_text: 她自己心情并未恢复正常，但不能袖手旁观，只得写一首诗：

en.t: Her own feelings had not yet returned to calm, but she could not simply stand aside, so she had no choice but to write a poem:
